calibration_rule: Fit one temperature on the four training brands' calibration split only. Freeze that temperature. Apply it unchanged to in-domain validation and to the held-out brand.
checkpoint_selection_rule: Select only on the four training brands' validation split. Maximum validation PR-AUC subject to false_authentic_rate <= 0.02. Ties prefer higher F1, then lower false-authentic rate, then lower validation loss, then the earlier epoch. The held-out brand and the locked final test are not inputs. The decision threshold stays 0.50 and is not tuned.
dinov2_baseline: deferred; a second backbone family would materially expand this phase
duplicate_policy: Exact SHA-256 copies and the audited dHash groups stay in one role. A group that touches the locked final test is excluded. A training-brand image that shares a duplicate group with the held-out brand is quarantined.
initialization: timm pretrained vit_base_patch16_dinov3.lvd1689m. The frozen epoch_018.pt checkpoint is not loaded.
mean_generalization_gap_definition: mean over folds of in-domain PR-AUC minus unseen-brand PR-AUC
research_question: Can DINOv3 learn authenticity cues that generalize to a luxury-watch brand that was completely unseen during training?
secondary_ablation: cls_only versus cls_patch_attention on the same fold manifests
source_identity: UNKNOWN on every catalog row, so source-family disjointness is not claimed
